latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Church Event Planner skill.

- Plan and manage all types of church events—gatherings, services, fundraisers, retreats, VBS, potlucks, weddings, funerals, and more.
- Track events, task checklists, vendors, and volunteers in a single, organized workflow.
- Built-in smart templates for common events like VBS, potlucks, special services, and retreats offer ready-to-use planning checklists.
- All event data is persistently stored and updated in a structured JSON file for accuracy and continuity.
- Automatically triggers when users mention any aspect of event planning, even in casual conversation.
